defuss-shadcn / Geography / geo-geodesy

Built with: CSS JS

GPS & GeodesyATM

A GPS position is a longitude and a latitude on the WGS84 ellipsoid, and the shortest way between two of them is a geodesic on that ellipsoid - not a straight line on any map. df$.shadcn.geo solves both geodesic problems with GeographicLib (Karney's algorithm, accurate to nanometres and stable for nearly antipodal points): inverse(a, b) gives the distance and the bearings, direct(origin, bearing, meters) where that leads, path(a, b) the line to draw. Positions are always [longitude, latitude], the GeoJSON order.

§Distance and bearings

Call await df$.shadcn.geo.load() once (a map does it for you), then every function is synchronous. inverse returns metres along the surface and the bearings at both ends, in degrees clockwise from north; a reference ellipsoid other than WGS84 is the last argument ({ a, f } - f: 0 is a sphere). The distance excludes altitude, terrain and roads.

§Measure between two GPS positions

Edit either position (longitude, latitude) and press Measure: the line is the geodesic, the readout compares WGS84 with a sphere of the mean Earth radius.

×%

§Geodesic lines

path(a, b, maxStepMeters) samples the geodesic at most that far apart (20 km by default); the map draws the samples, and between them its own spherical resampling. On Mercator a long geodesic bends toward the pole - it is the straight line on the globe. A map's layers JSON draws one directly: { "id": "x", "from": [..], "to": [..] }.

§The same lines on a map and a globe

×%

§Where a bearing leads

direct(origin, bearing, meters) is the other half: from a position, in a direction, for a distance. Twelve bearings of 1,500 km each make a ring that is round on the ground - and visibly not round on Mercator.

§1,500 km in every direction

×%

§What the numbers mean

WGS84 is the GPS reference ellipsoid - a model of the Earth's shape, about 21 km flatter at the poles than at the equator. A geodesic distance is the shortest path on that surface: no altitude, no terrain, no roads - a road route is its own number (see Routing). The map projects on a sphere, so a drawn geodesic is the ellipsoidal one sampled, then resampled spherically between samples; no pixel error bound is claimed.

§CSS view file

The library lives in the Geo Map component - the stylesheet is the map's.

@layer components {
  .geo-map {
    /* the map's own colors: derived from the theme, literal where the theme has no token (water, routes, cells) */
    --geo-map-ocean: color-mix(in oklab, var(--background) 90%, #6c9bab);
    --geo-map-grid: color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) 13%, transparent);
    --geo-map-border: color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) 38%, transparent);
    --geo-map-route: #c14e2e;
    --geo-map-cell-fill: color-mix(in oklab, #4e958b 32%, transparent);
    --geo-map-cell-border: #347871;
    --geo-map-select: var(--primary);
    --geo-map-mix: 100%;
    --geo-map-callout-width: 10rem;
    --geo-map-callout-size: 0.875rem;
    --geo-map-tone-0: #bcc9b5;
    --geo-map-tone-1: #c7cfb0;
    --geo-map-tone-2: #d5ceac;
    --geo-map-tone-3: #aabfba;
    --geo-map-tone-4: #b9bdca;
    --geo-map-tone-5: #d7c0b3;
    --geo-map-tone-6: #aac3bc;
    position: relative;
    isolation: isolate;
    overflow: hidden;
    block-size: var(--geo-map-height, 28rem);
    min-block-size: 16rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background: var(--card);
    color: var(--card-foreground);
    font-family: var(--font-sans);
    &[data-palette="ocean"] {
      --geo-map-tone-0: #c6e2e9;
      --geo-map-tone-1: #a9cedd;
      --geo-map-tone-2: #8bbaca;
      --geo-map-tone-3: #72a0bd;
      --geo-map-tone-4: #668da9;
      --geo-map-tone-5: #89b5ba;
      --geo-map-tone-6: #b9d4dd;
    }
    &[data-palette="forest"] {
      --geo-map-tone-0: #dce5be;
      --geo-map-tone-1: #bbd09c;
      --geo-map-tone-2: #9abc91;
      --geo-map-tone-3: #7ca795;
      --geo-map-tone-4: #67958d;
      --geo-map-tone-5: #a5c9ae;
      --geo-map-tone-6: #cbd9ac;
    }
    &[data-palette="sunset"] {
      --geo-map-tone-0: #e9c4ad;
      --geo-map-tone-1: #e7ad96;
      --geo-map-tone-2: #d99291;
      --geo-map-tone-3: #ca8097;
      --geo-map-tone-4: #ae80a6;
      --geo-map-tone-5: #c2a1ad;
      --geo-map-tone-6: #e4d0bb;
    }
    &[data-palette="heat"] {
      --geo-map-tone-0: #fee6a5;
      --geo-map-tone-1: #f9ca7b;
      --geo-map-tone-2: #f6a769;
      --geo-map-tone-3: #e97d61;
      --geo-map-tone-4: #d05b5e;
      --geo-map-tone-5: #a9475b;
      --geo-map-tone-6: #813954;
    }
    &[data-palette="mono"] {
      --geo-map-tone-0: var(--secondary);
      --geo-map-tone-1: var(--muted);
      --geo-map-tone-2: var(--accent);
      --geo-map-tone-3: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted) 70%, var(--foreground));
      --geo-map-tone-4: var(--secondary);
      --geo-map-tone-5: var(--muted);
      --geo-map-tone-6: var(--accent);
    }
    &[data-palette="chart"] {
      --geo-map-tone-0: color-mix(in oklab, var(--chart-1) 55%, var(--card));
      --geo-map-tone-1: color-mix(in oklab, var(--chart-2) 55%, var(--card));
      --geo-map-tone-2: color-mix(in oklab, var(--chart-3) 55%, var(--card));
      --geo-map-tone-3: color-mix(in oklab, var(--chart-4) 55%, var(--card));
      --geo-map-tone-4: color-mix(in oklab, var(--chart-5) 55%, var(--card));
      --geo-map-tone-5: color-mix(in oklab, var(--chart-1) 35%, var(--card));
      --geo-map-tone-6: color-mix(in oklab, var(--chart-3) 35%, var(--card));
    }
    &[data-variant="plain"] {
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 0;
      background: transparent;
    }
  }
  .dark .geo-map {
    --geo-map-ocean: color-mix(in oklab, var(--background) 92%, #5a9fb3);
    --geo-map-border: color-mix(in oklab, var(--background) 70%, transparent);
    --geo-map-grid: color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) 10%, transparent);
    --geo-map-route: #ff9c76;
    --geo-map-cell-fill: color-mix(in oklab, #54bbaf 25%, transparent);
    --geo-map-cell-border: #8adbd2;
    --geo-map-mix: 58%;
  }
  .geo-map-svg {
    display: block;
    inline-size: 100%;
    block-size: 100%;
    touch-action: none;
    cursor: grab;
    user-select: none;
    &:active {
      cursor: grabbing;
    }
    &:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
      outline-offset: -3px;
    }
  }
  .geo-map-sphere path {
    fill: var(--geo-map-ocean);
    stroke: var(--geo-map-grid);
  }
  .geo-map-graticule path {
    fill: none;
    stroke: var(--geo-map-grid);
    stroke-width: 0.6;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .geo-map-region {
    stroke: var(--geo-map-border);
    stroke-width: 0.65;
    stroke-linejoin: round;
    vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
    transition:
      fill 180ms ease,
      opacity 180ms ease,
      stroke 180ms ease;
    outline: none;
    &[data-tone="0"] {
      fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--geo-map-tone-0) var(--geo-map-mix), var(--background));
    }
    &[data-tone="1"] {
      fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--geo-map-tone-1) var(--geo-map-mix), var(--background));
    }
    &[data-tone="2"] {
      fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--geo-map-tone-2) var(--geo-map-mix), var(--background));
    }
    &[data-tone="3"] {
      fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--geo-map-tone-3) var(--geo-map-mix), var(--background));
    }
    &[data-tone="4"] {
      fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--geo-map-tone-4) var(--geo-map-mix), var(--background));
    }
    &[data-tone="5"] {
      fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--geo-map-tone-5) var(--geo-map-mix), var(--background));
    }
    &[data-tone="6"] {
      fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--geo-map-tone-6) var(--geo-map-mix), var(--background));
    }
    &:focus-visible {
      stroke: var(--ring);
      stroke-width: 2.5;
    }
  }
  .geo-map-regions .geo-map-region:hover,
  .geo-map-cells .geo-map-region:hover {
    stroke: var(--foreground);
    stroke-width: 1.2;
  }
  /* around a focus: the rest of the world, dimmed and inert */
  .geo-map-context {
    pointer-events: none;
    & .geo-map-region {
      fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted) 70%, var(--geo-map-ocean));
      opacity: 0.55;
    }
  }
  .geo-map[data-border="none"] :is(.geo-map-regions, .geo-map-context) .geo-map-region {
    stroke: none;
  }
  .geo-map[data-border="dashed"] :is(.geo-map-regions, .geo-map-context) .geo-map-region {
    stroke-dasharray: 3 2;
  }
  .geo-map[data-border="cased"] :is(.geo-map-regions, .geo-map-context) .geo-map-region {
    stroke: var(--background);
    stroke-width: 2;
    paint-order: stroke fill;
  }
  /* the selection: fill (default), outline, pulse, lift */
  .geo-map-regions .geo-map-region[aria-pressed="true"],
  .geo-map-cells .geo-map-region[aria-pressed="true"] {
    fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--geo-map-select) 62%, var(--card));
    stroke: var(--geo-map-select);
    stroke-width: 1.4;
  }
  .geo-map[data-highlight="outline"] :is(.geo-map-regions, .geo-map-cells) .geo-map-region[aria-pressed="true"] {
    fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--geo-map-select) 14%, transparent);
    stroke: var(--geo-map-select);
    stroke-width: 2.4;
    stroke-dasharray: 6 4;
    animation: geo-map-march 900ms linear infinite;
  }
  .geo-map[data-highlight="pulse"] :is(.geo-map-regions, .geo-map-cells) .geo-map-region[aria-pressed="true"] {
    animation: geo-map-pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .geo-map[data-highlight="lift"] :is(.geo-map-regions, .geo-map-cells) .geo-map-region[aria-pressed="true"] {
    fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) 22%, var(--geo-map-ocean));
    stroke: none;
  }
  @keyframes geo-map-march {
    to {
      stroke-dashoffset: -20;
    }
  }
  @keyframes geo-map-pulse {
    50% {
      fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--geo-map-select) 28%, var(--card));
      stroke-width: 3;
    }
  }
  /* hover (and data-highlight="lift"): a copy of the region raised a little, its shadow on the map below */
  .geo-map-lift {
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .geo-map-lifted {
    stroke: var(--foreground);
    stroke-width: 1;
    stroke-linejoin: round;
    vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
    translate: 0 -3px;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.28));
    transition:
      translate 160ms ease-out,
      filter 160ms ease-out;
    @starting-style {
      translate: 0 0;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0));
    }
    &[data-tone="0"] {
      fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--geo-map-tone-0) var(--geo-map-mix), var(--background));
    }
    &[data-tone="1"] {
      fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--geo-map-tone-1) var(--geo-map-mix), var(--background));
    }
    &[data-tone="2"] {
      fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--geo-map-tone-2) var(--geo-map-mix), var(--background));
    }
    &[data-tone="3"] {
      fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--geo-map-tone-3) var(--geo-map-mix), var(--background));
    }
    &[data-tone="4"] {
      fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--geo-map-tone-4) var(--geo-map-mix), var(--background));
    }
    &[data-tone="5"] {
      fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--geo-map-tone-5) var(--geo-map-mix), var(--background));
    }
    &[data-tone="6"] {
      fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--geo-map-tone-6) var(--geo-map-mix), var(--background));
    }
    &[aria-pressed="true"] {
      fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--geo-map-select) 62%, var(--card));
      stroke: var(--geo-map-select);
    }
    &.geo-map-cell {
      fill: var(--geo-map-cell-fill);
      stroke: var(--geo-map-cell-border);
    }
  }
  .geo-map[data-highlight="lift"] .geo-map-lifted[aria-pressed="true"] {
    translate: 0 -5px;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 7px 5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.32));
  }
  .geo-map-cells .geo-map-region {
    fill: var(--geo-map-cell-fill);
    stroke: var(--geo-map-cell-border);
    stroke-width: 1.2;
  }
  .geo-map-lines {
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .geo-map-line {
    fill: none;
    stroke: var(--geo-map-route);
    stroke-width: 2.5;
    stroke-linecap: round;
    stroke-linejoin: round;
    vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
  }
  .geo-map-markers {
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .geo-map-marker {
    & > :not(text) {
      fill: var(--geo-map-route);
      stroke: var(--background);
      stroke-width: 2;
    }
    & text {
      font: 500 11px var(--font-sans);
      fill: var(--foreground);
      stroke: var(--background);
      stroke-width: 3px;
      paint-order: stroke;
      stroke-linejoin: round;
    }
  }
  .geo-map-hatch {
    fill: none;
    stroke: var(--muted-foreground);
    stroke-width: 1;
  }
  /* callouts: a leader line from each region to its name outside the map, the name written on the line */
  .geo-map-callout {
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .geo-map-callout-line {
    fill: none;
    stroke: color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) 45%, transparent);
    stroke-width: 0.8;
    vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
  }
  .geo-map-callout-dot {
    fill: var(--foreground);
  }
  /* the script spaces the rows and shortens the names by this size (--geo-map-callout-size) */
  .geo-map-callout-label {
    font: 500 var(--geo-map-callout-size) var(--font-sans);
    fill: var(--foreground);
  }
  .geo-map-callout:is([data-hover], [data-selected]) {
    & .geo-map-callout-line {
      stroke: var(--geo-map-select);
      stroke-width: 1.6;
    }
    & .geo-map-callout-dot {
      fill: var(--geo-map-select);
    }
    & .geo-map-callout-label {
      fill: var(--geo-map-select);
      font-weight: 600;
    }
  }
  .geo-map-tooltip {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 3;
    max-inline-size: 14rem;
    padding: 0.35rem 0.6rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    color: var(--popover-foreground);
    background: var(--popover);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    pointer-events: none;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
    &[hidden] {
      display: none;
    }
  }
  .geo-map-error {
    position: absolute;
    inset: auto 1rem 1rem;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--destructive);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    color: var(--destructive);
    background: var(--card);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
  }
  .geo-map[data-geo-status="loading"] .geo-map-svg {
    animation: geo-map-loading 1.2s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }
  @keyframes geo-map-loading {
    to {
      opacity: 0.55;
    }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .geo-map-region,
    .geo-map-lifted {
      transition: none;
    }
    .geo-map[data-highlight] :is(.geo-map-regions, .geo-map-cells) .geo-map-region[aria-pressed="true"],
    .geo-map[data-geo-status="loading"] .geo-map-svg {
      animation: none;
    }
  }
  @media (prefers-contrast: more) {
    .geo-map {
      --geo-map-border: var(--foreground);
    }
    .geo-map-region {
      stroke-width: 1;
    }
    .geo-map-callout-line {
      stroke: var(--foreground);
    }
  }
  @media (forced-colors: active) {
    .geo-map-sphere path {
      fill: Canvas;

function decode(bytes: Uint8Array): GeoTopology {

    if (!Array.isArray(t.arcs) || t.arcs.length > MAX_ARCS) throw new Error('invalid arcs');
    checkTopology(t, t.arcs.length);

  if (offset(0) !== 0 || offset(count) !== rawLength) throw new Error('invalid DGEO offset table');

    const start = offset(k);

    const end = base + stop;

  const top = Math.min(90, north + 0.1);

        [a, top],

      ring.push([b, bottom]);

interface GeoManifest {

}

  proxies: Map<string, GeoRegion>;

const datasets = new Map<string, Promise<Dataset>>();
const CACHE_BYTES = 24 * 1024 * 1024;

        countries: [],

        ds.bytes -= entry.bytes;

      const parent = r.properties.parent ? ds.byKey.get(`country:${r.properties.parent}`)?.properties.name : '';

function init(): void {
  (dfDollar('.geo-map:not([data-init])').toArray() as HTMLElement[]).forEach((el) => {
    el.dataset.init = '';
    bindControls();
    mount(el);
    const geo = el._geo as GeoInstance;
    // el.store + el.api (AGENTS.md "State through stores"): the state the attributes declare
    const name = stateNameOf(geo.view);
    bindComponent(el, geoMapApi, { name, config: configOf(geo) as unknown as Record<string, unknown> });
    // the first state change waits for the engines and the data: el.api.settled() resolves once the map is drawn
    void geoMapApi.setState(el, name, {});
  });
}
init();
new MutationObserver(init).observe(document, { childList: true, subtree: true });
